Header references the fetched SVG as bank logo, and homepage includes 2026 shareholder notices. SVG contains a separately bounded four-path red/blue/gray angular square emblem beside lettering and descriptive tagline. Original rendered source inspected.

Fetched article dated 12 February 2020 states Bank Trust changed brand style and logo to a tricolor-inspired design, quoting chairman Alexander Sokolov. Previous change was in 2011. This establishes a documented same-bank rebrand rather than replacing the record with another bank.
